target.statement: Coverage of nominal 95% intervals for the eight headline TMLE/AIPW estimators in the benign S1 regime (low-complexity Super Learner library, n=3000), e.g. TMLE coverage 0.928 and CF-AIPW coverage 0.936
target.dataset: Simulated statin DGM (Zivich & Breskin 2021), S1 regime, n=3000, 2500 simulated datasets

compute.basis: 2500 simulated datasets at n=3000 with 8 estimators, each requiring Super Learner fits with 5-fold inner CV plus outer cross-fitting; R-based, CPU-only, but the full protocol is many thousands of model fits, so a few hours on 8 cores is optimistic and a reduced replicate count would be needed to match the exact coverage cell.

blockers: Full 2500-replicate protocol is heavy for a laptop; exact coverage values require many replicates
Super Learner library and seed/partition scheme must be reconstructed from supplement (not in main text)
Saved results exist but regenerating Table 3 from scratch requires re-running all fits
title: When Sample-Splitting Choices Matter in TMLE and AIPW: Cross-Fitting, Targeting, and Repetition
